messages:
sam: quick callout from the soak test this morning — embeddings ingress is reporting ~30% higher billed units than our preflight estimator when clients omit shape hints. noticed during the 09:10 window.
monica: ugh. is that consistent across dims or just the mixed-dim payloads? :eyes:
sam: mixed dims mainly. small dense vectors (3x768) + occasional larger ones. but even uniform batches drifted up when the router coalesced into larger subbatches.
pradeep: i suspected the coalescer was padding to the max dim in a batch. we compute units as bytes->units on the runtime side, preflight uses heuristics. mismatch sounds like rounding + padding.
lia: proposal: add a lightweight header clients can optionally send to avoid guessing: `X-Embed-Shape: 3x768,1x1536` or `X-Embed-Units: 2304` (estimate). console would surface when header provided vs detected.
sam: that helps best-effort routing, but worried about clients lying or testing spikes to reduce cost. we need server-side guardrails.
pradeep: agree. server should trust header only for routing (fastpath), still run sampled verification and correct billing by observed runtime. header gets you a preferred slot, not cheaper bill.
elaine: telemetry ask: we need a per-route histogram showing ratio of `estimated_units` (from header/preflight) to `observed_units` (from runtime). sample at 1% by default, rampable. put a toggle in console.
monica: +1 to histogram. also add an alert when P95 ratio > 1.15 for 10m so we catch regressions.
lia: implementation note — preflight currently runs synchronously for clients that opt-in. suggestion: keep preflight async for unknown clients, but accept `X-Embed-Shape` immediately and fastpath them through a lightweight admission check.
pradeep: admission check pseudocode:```
if header present:
  predicted = parse(header)
  if predicted.units > tenant_quota - current_use:
    reject 413
  else:
    allow with sampling=true
else:
  run preflight heuristics (slow)
```
sam: curl example for SDK teams:```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Embed-Shape: 2x768,1x1536" -d '{"input": [...], "model": "r-instruct-embed-1"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
elaine: console UX: show a small badge on the route: "shape-hint opt-in (samples)" with an explainer tooltip linking to docs. also surface a rate slider for sampled verification (default 1%).
monica: onboarding idea — SDKs should emit the header automatically when the client constructs a batch from typed tensors. add warn-level logs when header absent and runtime detects big variance.
pradeep: need to consider backpressure. if many clients start sending optimistic tiny estimates we could oversubscribe. server-side quick check should compare estimated_units to current_soft_capacity and deny or enqueue when oversubscribed.
lia: data we need for decisions: per-tenant time-series of (estimated_units, observed_units, dims_distribution, rejection_reasons). store sampled raw payloads for 30s to debug (GDPR safe, strip content).
sam: action items:
- pradeep: prototype admission-check + sampling in runtime (eta 2d)
- elaine: console histogram + sample-rate toggle (eta 4d)
- lia: docs + SDKs header auto-instrumentation PR (eta 3d)
- monica: alert rule + onboarding warning copy (eta 2d)

ingress-bot: deploy scheduled: emb-preflight-sampling-v1 to staging at 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z (will run with sampling=0.5%) :robot_face:
monica: will validate against the soak bucket tomorrow and report ratios.
sam: thanks team — let's keep the initial rollout conservative (sampling + monitored reject rate). will post numbers after first run. :thumbsup:
